history.summary: An 818 sqft '1BR' freehold in D23 (Hillview/Bukit Batok fringe) at $990K / $1,210 PSF. The below-median PSF is partly a large-unit artifact (818 sqft is oversized for 1BR), the resale appreciation is weak (+1.73%/yr over just 22 txns), and the MRT is 1.86km / 22 min away — a poor location and lagging appreciation outweigh the freehold tenure.
history.rating_rationale: Resale-only appreciation is only +1.73%/yr — the weakest in the batch — and on a thin 22-txn base. The $1,210 vs $1,556 median 'discount' is inflated by the oversized 818 sqft format, not genuine value. Bukit Gombak MRT is 1.86km (22-min walk), so there is no transit support, and D23 here has no near-term catalyst. Freehold is the only real positive and does not offset stagnant prices plus weak connectivity.
red_flags: Resale appreciation only +1.73%/yr (22 txns) — stagnant and unreliable
818 sqft oversized for a 1BR — below-median PSF is a size artifact, not value
Boutique/small D23 development — limited liquidity, no catalyst
catalysts: Quiet Hillview/Bukit Batok greenery appeals to an own-stay niche
